observations.condition: A two-point strand and a Collider implementation that reports +infinity with finite up direction for the root but a finite negative distance for the other point. This is a public trait-input condition, not a shown ordinary shipped producer or constructed fixture.
observations.source_reasoning: With default lock_roots=true, Shrinkwrap assigns the root zero weight but still evaluates p + up*(offset - infinity). Vec3 multiplication is componentwise; IEEE 0*infinity and then multiplying nonfinite movement by zero produce NaN. The inside second point sets any=true. For two points blur returns unchanged; the final loop adds every movement to its corresponding position, including the locked root. The no-collider implementation returns infinity for every point, for which any remains false and the operation returns before mutating.
observations.historical_attribution: Adler READ-L11-369 previously explicitly identified the conditional 0*infinity/mixed-any possibility but left actual Collider source uninspected; this bounded trace adds the current trait, NoCollider, vector operations and blur support. It is not a newly unique historical finding.
observations.limitations: No Collider implementation, points, float operation, fixture or product path was executed. A shipped mixed finite/infinite producer, impact, supported-distance policy and exact global aliases remain open. NoCollider alone is not a witness.
